nativeStorage.upgradeOrigin: Keep the existing v1 mutable state frozen at its last acknowledged revision and verify it against the original raw snapshot. Never reconstruct completed v2 data from that origin automatically.
nativeStorage.upgradeLease: Create v2 tables and seven values inside a verified v1 no-op write lease. Commit or roll back through that same lease; old values are not rewritten.
nativeStorage.authority: Reserve an independent version-2 authority receipt before upgrade; confirm after durable read-back and before exposing the UI. A reserved upgrade can recover the same origin. Completed authority blocks missing-v2 fallback.
nativeStorage.downgrade: The version-2 receipt makes previous app code refuse stale v1 access. A later device candidate must increment the Android build and preserve export/restore compatibility.
nativeStorage.writes: Seven slots share one compare-and-swap revision. Rewrite only changed slots; validate chunk hashes, canonical JSON and the preserved origin. Unknown commit results require reopening.

appIntegration.completeExport: Native v2 exports sintonema.audiovisual-backup v1 with all six exact raw values and typed progress.
appIntegration.completeRestore: Restore all raw values and progress atomically and clear poster guards only after acknowledgement.
appIntegration.legacyRestore: Legacy/v1-v4 and six-key complete backups remain accepted. They change only their corresponding legacy values and retain audiovisual progress.
appIntegration.legacyExport: If audiovisual progress exists, direct the user to the complete export instead of producing a reduced movie-only file.
appIntegration.browserLimit: The browser retains the coordinated legacy adapter for now. It can import an audiovisual envelope with empty progress but refuses nonempty progress without touching existing values. Browser progress support is a separate integration task.
appIntegration.newTitlesScope: Eight reviewed TVmaze series/programmes are packaged locally in a separate library view; no new APK is generated by this package.
appIntegration.backupCompatibility: Existing legacy/movie backups remain accepted. New code accepts local, TMDb and TVmaze progress identities. Older builds without TVmaze support refuse a nonempty TVmaze backup before mutation; preserve the complete file and use a compatible newer app.

nativeValidation.scope: Exact ea3a5ac pilot source; both final reports revalidated against the Python controller. Candidate changes release metadata, artifact verification and planning, not the approved app/storage graph.

releaseGates: Apply and verify this device-candidate preparation on the exact ea3a5ac base.
Pass the actual signed-APK CI job for the candidate source, with no audit probe and the reviewed pilot/tracking UI packaged.
Compare the produced APK hash, package/version and signer before installation as an update.
Test pilot progress, complete export/restore, offline write/reopen and data preservation on the existing Android installation.
Implement the public first-access/admin specification separately, with storage and service changes tested before release.
Complete real iPhone, rights, privacy, recovery/performance and store gates.
